tricks.name: Disco Flip
tricks.description: A Disco Flip (also known as a heelflip sex change) is a heelflip combined with a backside body varial. In skate., perform it by doing a nollie varial heelflip while adding a backside 180. The frontside shove-it from the varial heel cancels out the board rotation from the BS 180, leaving the board to perform only a heelflip while your body rotates 180° backside, landing switch.
